_: junit.xml and rerun.junit.xml (its failed tests, run again) read as one run's tests, by qaboard/junit.py (merge_reports, tests/test_junit.py) and webapp/src/viewers/junit/parse.js (mergeJunitReports, webapp/src/viewers/__tests__/junit.test.js). A test in both is one test: flaky when it failed in one and passed in the other, with the time of its first report.
